name: web-data-visualization
description: Integrates source-grounded editorial or scientific visualizations into existing web surfaces with semantic companions and coherent view state. Applies to static charts, SVG galleries, and coordinated interactive views whose delivery, responsive behavior, or export affects interpretation.

contract.what: A web visualization whose source, visual grammar, state, semantic companion, and portable output form one coherent reader surface.
when: A website or digital instrument needs a new or materially revised static figure, scientific plot, gallery, or coordinated set of views.
boundaries: The receiving repository owns styles, source generation, state, and publication. Source definitions and domain judgment retain authority over interpretation. Reuse precedes additional dependencies; a library or renderer enters for a demonstrated task need. Current delivery choices remain with the user.
contract.result: An integrated, inspectable figure or view family with usable static reading, intentional enhancement, and evidence for the changed behavior.

receivingUse.job: A website or digital instrument needs a new or materially revised static figure, scientific plot, gallery, or coordinated set of views.
receivingUse.materialResult: An integrated, inspectable figure or view family with usable static reading, intentional enhancement, and evidence for the changed behavior.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
